name: check_opencode_sessions
description: Fallback-only OpenCode session lookup via API. Lists recent OpenCode sessions or returns metadata for a specific session. READ-ONLY - does not trigger new builds. Use only when OpenCode produced no usable final result, timed out, or the user explicitly asks about OpenCode session status/logs. Do not call after a successful OpenCode build reply.

session_id.description: Optional: specific OpenCode session ID to get detailed info. If omitted, lists recent sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return when listing (default: 5)
